_source: https://catalyst.example.com/credits/v1/orders?owner=0x00009dc8aac69accf38e87ab42a82a28be68f2a0&status=open&first=3 (live catalyrst-market, fetched 2026-06-23). The cancel endpoint POST /credits/v1/federation/order/cancel requires a signed auth-chain (require_signer) and enforces 'only the order signer may cancel this order' (catalyrst-market/src/handlers/federation.rs::cancel_order), so the on-chain cancel is SIMULATED in the wizard. The OrderCancel message shape is { order_signature_hash, signed_at } (catalyrst-market/src/fed/messages.rs).
_note: Used as the fixture fallback when the live catalyst orders query is empty/unreachable. The default owner below is the live test seller whose open Order rows are returned by the orders endpoint; the route also accepts ?owner= and ?order= to target a specific live order.
